expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: Shanghai first, then Xi'an, then Beijing. Running the route this way means the Great Wall is the last thing you see, not the first.
expert.tip: The Indian lunch and dinner are worth keeping. After five days of regional Chinese food most families are glad of one familiar plate.

summary: Eight days from the modern waterfront of Shanghai to the terracotta army at Xi'an and imperial Beijing, with a bullet train leg, daily breakfast and an Indian lunch and dinner on the way.
included: Included: 7 nights with daily breakfast across Shanghai, Xi'an and Beijing; one Indian lunch and one Indian dinner; private transfers; half day guided Shanghai city tour; Oriental Pearl Tower tickets; Huangpu river cruise tickets; guided Xi'an sightseeing tour; Xi'an to Beijing bullet train; full day Great Wall at Mutianyu with the Summer Palace; guided Beijing city sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Shanghai to Xi'an internal flight; China visa fees; meals beyond those listed; travel insurance; personal expenses.
